name: Apple Crumble Pie
ingredients: Apple (42%), Wheat Flour (Thiamine), Sugar, Margarine [Vegetable Oil, Water, Salt, Milk Solids, Emulsifiers (471, 472c), Antioxidants (307, 304), Natural Flavour, Natural Colour (Carotene)], Thickener (1412), Dextrose, Whey Powder (Milk), Salt, Cinnamon, Lemon Juice Concentrate, Raising Agent (Sodium Bicarbonate), Citric Acid, Processing Aid (Wheat).
storage: Frozen fresh. Store at or below minus 18ºC. If contents become thawed, use as soon as possible. Do not refreeze.
note: PEANUT WARNING: the may-contain statement names Peanuts and Tree Nuts. Back panel only — the front of pack was not photographed, so the exact product name is taken from the back panel copy ("Bake your Crumble Pie", "AUSSIE-GROWN APPLES", first ingredient Apple 42%). Net weight is not printed on the back panel; 10 servings x 80 g is stated but that is arithmetic, so pack is left unrecorded. No barcode or country-of-origin statement in frame.
